BACKGROUND

A little background

“Only You” was the third release in a series by the brand Bargobargo on moments of love and parting, after releases with Jung In and 2AM’s Jeong Jinwoon. In the release notes, Yebit describes the song as lonely and composed, with a heaviness that settles in.

INSIDE THE LYRICS

When the place stays the same

  • Longing
  • Changing relationships

Seoul Forest remains familiar while the relationship has changed. Walking there alone makes the difference harder to ignore: a shared place can keep reminding someone of a closeness that no longer feels secure.

The speaker tries to look all right, with a smile that conceals hurt. The person they find painful to face is also the person they want to lean on. That makes the request for comfort unresolved; affection and distress lead back to the same person, and outward composure gives little indication of what remains inside.
